review_type: Rapid structured review with a documented search strategy; not an exhaustive systematic review
scope: Compression of recorded EEG waveforms, with emphasis on quantization, reconstructed-signal quality and preservation of downstream decisions. Confidence estimation is an adjacent method, not a compressor.
search_method: General web discovery followed by primary publisher, conference, institutional-repository and official-dataset pages. Backward reference checking from the SSVEP, neural source coding and confidence papers. No complete bibliographic-database exports, independent second screener or deduplicated candidate census.

inclusion: Direct EEG waveform compression or quantization with reconstruction or downstream-task evaluation
Representative classical, transform, task-aware and neural approaches
Primary publication or verifiable author manuscript; clearly labelled preprints permitted for recent context
Adjacent confidence paper retained to motivate, rather than establish, the compression hypothesis
exclusion: Classifier weight pruning or model quantization without compression of the recorded EEG input
fMRI-only, image-only, ECG-only or EMG-only compression
Compression as a cognitive metaphor or a signal-complexity marker without waveform coding
Unverified project-repository performance claims and promotional material
Studies inaccessible beyond a snippet were not used for detailed numerical conclusions

counts.note: These are counts of the selected bibliography, not PRISMA screening counts. No exhaustive screened-record total is claimed.

access_limitations: PubMed/PMC sometimes returned bot checks. Memon 1999 and Higgins 2013 were summarized from complete indexed abstracts, without claiming a full-text methods audit.
Wang 2024 was assessed using its PubMed abstract; full-text implementation details were not audited.
Full text was available for the selected SSVEP, neural source coding, BrainCodec, confidence and ADaCoRe papers, but this is a focused reading rather than a line-by-line replication audit.
Kastrati 2025 was assessed at abstract level and labelled as an arXiv preprint; workshop commentary does not establish archival peer-review status.
The Damoah-Liang author manuscript contains a placeholder DOI. It is contextual material, not a verified archival publication or a source of numerical benchmarks.
